ticket.title: Automatically Waive Consultation Fees for Return Visits Within 7 Days
ticket.text:
Automatically Waive Consultation Fees for Return Visits Within 7 Days

Automatically waive consultation fees for return visits within 7 days to avoid overcharging patients for follow-up care.

User Story:

- As a system admin, I want the system to handle recent visits (within 7 days) without generating a new consultation bill, so that we don't overcharge patients for follow-up care.

Functional Requirements:

- Recent Visit Detection:
  - System checks for previous visits within the last 7 days upon patient check-in
  - If a recent visit exists:
    - No new consultation bill is created
    - Payment status displays: PAID (for consultation)
    - Patient bypasses the cashier and proceeds directly to triage/consultation
- New Services During Follow-Up Visit:
  - If the clinician orders new services (lab tests, medications, procedures):
    - The system creates a bill for these new services only
    - Payment status changes to UNPAID (for new services)
    - Patient must visit the cashier to pay before lab/pharmacy services
- No New Services:
  - If no new services are ordered, payment status remains PAID
  - Patient completes visit without seeing the cashier
- Unpaid Initial Visit:
  - If the patient did not pay during the initial visit:
    - The outstanding balance from the initial visit remains visible
    - The new consultation fee is still waived
    - Payment status shows UNPAID for initial visit items
    - Patient sees the cashier to settle the previous balance + any new services

understanding.intent: Automatically waive consultation fees and mark consultation payment as paid for return visits within 7 days during patient check-in.

criteria.text: When a patient checks in who had a previous visit within the last 7 days, no new consultation bill is created.
criteria.quote:
System checks for previous visits within the last 7 days upon patient check-in
  - If a recent visit exists:
    - No new consultation bill is created

criteria.text: When a return visit within 7 days is detected, payment status displays as PAID for consultation and the patient bypasses the cashier directly to triage or consultation.
criteria.quote:
Payment status displays: PAID (for consultation)
    - Patient bypasses the cashier and proceeds directly to triage/consultation

criteria.text: If a clinician orders new services during the follow-up visit, a bill is created for only the new services and payment status updates to UNPAID for new services.
criteria.quote:
The system creates a bill for these new services only
    - Payment status changes to UNPAID (for new services)
    - Patient must visit the cashier to pay before lab/pharmacy services

criteria.text: If no new services are ordered during the follow-up visit, payment status remains PAID and the patient completes the visit without visiting the cashier.
criteria.quote:
If no new services are ordered, payment status remains PAID
  - Patient completes visit without seeing the cashier

criteria.text: If the initial visit had an unpaid balance, that outstanding balance remains visible, payment status displays UNPAID for initial visit items, but the new consultation fee is still waived.
criteria.quote:
The outstanding balance from the initial visit remains visible
    - The new consultation fee is still waived
    - Payment status shows UNPAID for initial visit items
